_comment: The network profiles this build knows (K6 network switch). ONE source for chain id, genesis, node network, RPC, explorer, faucet, bootnodes and address book, read by the Rust side (src-tauri/src/network_profile.rs) and the webview (src/network/profile.ts). `active` is the network this build targets. A value that is not known yet is null and named in `pending` with what sets it; it is never a placeholder. A profile with any null field is not ready, and the app refuses to start a node or sign against it.

pending.chainId: owner decision D1 in the C2 genesis spec (recommended: keep 40204)
pending.nodeNetwork: the explicit genesis profile name from chain work item G1 (C2 decision D10)
pending.rpcUrl: chain team, with the fleet for the new genesis
pending.explorerUrl: chain team, with the explorer reindex for the new genesis
pending.bootnodes: chain team, from the bootnodes of the new genesis fleet (Join 7)
pending.addressBook: the address book generated after the genesis contract deploy (frozen at rehearsal 1)
